labels: A rectangular satchel has a flap over its front and one strap running diagonally from the opposite shoulder to the bag at the hip.; 네모난 사첼의 앞면을 덮개가 덮고 끈 하나가 반대쪽 어깨에서 엉덩이 옆 가방까지 대각선으로 이어진다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A rectangular satchel has a flap over its front and one strap running diagonally from the opposite shoulder to the bag at the hip.
aliases: 사첼과 크로스바디 경로
